Course Blueprint
JAGGAER Product Configuration Certification JA -PLT -2 3 00 -C: JAGGAER Advantage Platform Configuration Specialization (Prerequisite: JA- PLT -2100 – JAGGAER Advantage Foundations )

This course follows the solution -focused content of JAGGAER Advantage Foundations with a deeper dive into the platform initial setup of the site, supplier, administration, sourcing, and user management components. Topics, all centered around implementation of a JA instance, include the instance creation process, user setup, instance -wide data configuration, product specific -data configuration , automation, and reporting. Participants will learn how to work with team member s and the customer to launch a properly configured JAGGAER Advantage site.
This course is offered in a classroom with instructor -led sessions. An eLearning version is available with approval.
Upon completion of this course and its requirements (Task List, Capstone Product and Exam), participants will be Certified JAGGAER Advantage Configuration Specialists.
Time Required: After prerequisites; this class requires approximately XX+ hours classroom time plus labs, assignments, tas k list, capstone product, and certification exam.
